question.problem:
Suppose we want to measure the mass of a flat-screen TV. Which of the following customary units could we use?

I. $\textrm{yd}$

II. $\textrm{ft}$

III. $\textrm{lb}$
question.worked_solution:
A table showing the customary units of mass is given below.

| Name | Symbol |
| --- | --- |
| Ton | $\textrm{ton}$ |
| Pound | $\textrm{lb}$ |
| Ounce | $\textrm{oz}$ |

Therefore, from the given options, the only unit of mass is $\textrm{lb}.$
